$Comment: The Scarak Brood Queen as she rises: the role the Sands_Brood_Queen_Marker spawn marker raises when the Brood Queen encounter script (Server/EncounterManager/Sands_Brood_Queen_Encounter.json) begins the fight. She is the game's own Scarak broodmother with a bigger pool and her own name; everything about how she fights (the rubble throw, the fighters she calls when alerted, the lice she keeps hatching) is Template_Scarak_Broodmother's. MaxHealth here is the whole fight's pool: the script changes her role in place to _Phase2 at half of it and to _Phase3 at half of what she carries into _Phase2, and the engine keeps her current health across each change, so the three roles together add up to this number. Raise it to lengthen the whole fight; the party scale in her binding row multiplies on top of it. _CombatConfig keeps the immunities every Scarak has. Modify may name only the parameters the template declares (MaxHealth, MaxSpeed, ViewRange, AlertedRange, DropList, Attack, AttackDistance and the like) plus _CombatConfig; one undeclared key and the engine refuses the whole role.
